items.title: Rechtsextreme Anschlagspläne in Winsen: Weitere Festnahme
items.teaser: In einer Neonazi-Chatgruppe sollen ein 15- und ein 19-Jähriger einen Brandanschlag geplant haben. Nun sitzt auch der ältere der beiden in U-Haft.

items.title: World Boxing Council maintains sanctions against Russia and Belarus
items.teaser: The World Boxing Council (WBC) has officially decided to maintain sanctions against representatives of Russia and Belarus.

items.title: Überwachung in neuem Ausmaß?: GFF prüft Verfassungsbeschwerde gegen Geheimdienstreform
items.teaser: Der Bundestag beschließt die größte Reform der Geheimdienste in der Geschichte der Bundesrepublik. Die Gesellschaft für Freiheitsrechte hält die neuen Befugnisse von BND und Verfassungsschutz jedoch für größtenteils verfassungswidrig. Die Organisation könnte in Karlsruhe Beschwerde einlegen.

items.title: Abstimmung - Bundestag billigt Reform der Geheimdienste - Befugnisse werden deutlich ausgeweitet
items.teaser: Der Bundestag hat den Gesetzentwurf zur Reform der Geheimdienste gebilligt. Mit der Novelle werden die Befugnisse des Bundesnachrichtendienstes und des Bundesamts für Verfassungsschutz zur Abwehr von Sabotage, Spionage und Cyberangriffen deutlich erweitert.

items.title: Neutral Moldova approves military cooperation deal with Ukraine as Russian drones violate its airspace
items.teaser: Moldova ratifies an agreement covering defense technology, cybersecurity, and airspace protection as Russian attacks on neighboring Ukraine increasingly spill across its borders.

items.title: Europe will be represented for first time at upcoming peace talks – Merz
items.teaser: Concrete peace talks on ending Russia's war against Ukraine are expected to take place in the coming weeks, with European representatives, including Germany, taking part directly.

items.title: We must return Ukrainian journalists still imprisoned in Russia
items.teaser: The plight of these journalists is complicated not only by unlawful arrests, but also by the fact that they were detained in Ukraine's temporarily occupied territories. Russian authorities illegally force Russian citizenship upon them and try them in occupation courts, seeking to sever them from any international legal

items.title: Politico: EU leaders close to agreeing on negotiating team for Ukraine talks
items.teaser: EU leaders are close to agreeing on a negotiating team involving Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland and EU institutions for talks on Ukraine, Politico reports.

items.title: Putin schlägt „humanitäre Aktion“ für Kostjantyniwka vor - Ukraine vermutet Plan dahinter
items.teaser: Die Russen könnten eine mögliche humanitäre Operation in Kostjantyniwka in der Region Donezk nutzen, um Soldaten auszuwechseln und Kriegsgerät dorthin zu verlegen, wie sie das zuvor in Oleschky getan haben, sagte der Sprecher des ukrainischen Präsidenten, Dmytro Lytwyn, vor der Presse.

items.title: Finland and Norway will stop Russian athletes at the border, even those federations cleared to compete
items.teaser: Both measures arrive just as the winter sports season opens on Finnish and Norwegian snow.

items.title: "Literally fighting for their lives": Human Rights Commissioner's Office shares stories of residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky
items.teaser: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky describe surviving on courgettes, being hunted by Russian drones and enduring years without appropriate medical care.

items.title: Kathrin Schmid, ARD Brüssel, zzt. Dublin, zu weiteren EU-Ukrainehilfen
items.teaser: Kathrin Schmid, ARD Brüssel, zzt. Dublin, zu weiteren EU-Ukrainehilfen

items.title: Ukraine und Russland greifen sich trotz Verhandlungen weiter an
items.teaser: Trotz intensiver Verhandlungen über ein Ende des Ukraine-Krieges dauern die gegenseitigen Angriffe zwischen Kiew und Moskau an. Russland meldet sieben Tote, in der Ukraine wurden mindestens zwei Menschen getötet.

items.title: Russian troops fail to advance toward Orikhiv – South Group of Forces
items.teaser: Russian troops are attempting to advance toward Orikhiv in the Zaporizhzhia region in small infantry groups, but Ukraine's Defense Forces detect them on the approaches to the city and engage them with fire.

items.title: Cyberattack hits German drone manufacturer supplying Ukraine in late October, company confirms
items.teaser: "Companies at the forefront of supporting Ukraine are being targeted precisely because our work is critically relevant to customers' security," the company said in its official statement.

items.title: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry welcomes TASS expulsion from European Alliance of News Agencies
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Foreign Ministry has welcomed the decision by the European Alliance of News Agencies (EANA) to expel Russia's state-owned news agency TASS from its membership.

items.title: 40 countries tell Russia: Ukraine’s security and Europe’s alliances are not yours to decide
items.teaser: The Dublin Declaration reaffirms every country's right to choose its alliances and says Ukraine's security is an integral part of Euro-Atlantic security.

items.title: EU einigt sich auf Verhandlungsteam für Ukraine-Gespräche
items.teaser: Die E5-Staaten sollen künftig Europa bei den Verhandlungen zur Ukraine vertreten. Zuvor wurde in und außerhalb Europas kritisiert, dass es keinen klaren Vertreter gibt.

items.title: Serbia's incoming ruling party declares support for Ukraine's sovereignty
items.teaser: The Student List party, which recently won a majority in Serbia's parliamentary elections, has published a document outlining its vision for the Balkan country's foreign policy agenda.

items.title: Merz beansprucht Teilnahme an künftigen Ukraine-Gesprächen
items.teaser: Der Krieg gegen die Ukraine steht im Fokus des EU-Treffens in Dublin. Kanzler Merz erhält für seinen Vorstoß zur Finanzierung neuer Ukraine-Hilfen Rückendeckung - bei Gesprächen über ein Kriegsende sieht er Deutschland als "gesetzt" an.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia on 13 November: number of injured rises to 50, including 8 children – photos
items.teaser: Mykhailo Semikin, Head of Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration, has reported that the number of people injured in a Russian attack on an industrial facility and a five-storey residential building in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district has risen to 50.

items.title: "The situation is very serious": Ukraine may have knocked out half of Russia's petrol production
items.teaser: The Moscow Times, citing an analyst, says attacks on Russia's largest refineries over the past two weeks may have halted about 55% of petrol production, risking shortages and queues at petrol stations.

items.title: Lubinets says potential humanitarian mission in Kostiantynivka not discussed
items.teaser: Preparing a humanitarian operation to evacuate people from the city of Kostiantynivka in the Donetsk region could take anywhere from several weeks to several months, but the possibility of organizing such a mission has not yet been discussed.

items.title: Starshield -Einschränkungen über russisch besetztem Gebiet der Ukraine festgestellt
items.teaser: Störungen bei der Funktionsweise von Starshield werden derzeit über dem gesamten vorübergehend von Russland besetzten Gebiet der Ukraine festgestellt. Auf dem von der Ukraine kontrollierten Gebiet werden keine Einschränkungen gemeldet.

items.title: USA stellen europäische Beteiligung bei zukünftigen Ukraine-Gesprächen in Aussicht
items.teaser: USA stellen europäische Beteiligung bei zukünftigen Ukraine-Gesprächen in Aussicht

items.title: Cyberangriff auf Quantum Systems: Wie wurde der Drohnenhersteller zum Ziel?
items.teaser: Nach dem Cyberangriff auf den bayerischen Drohnenhersteller Quantum Systems läuft die Suche nach den Tätern. Vieles deutet auf einen russischen Hintergrund hin. Das Unternehmen ist wichtiger Ausrüster des ukrainischen Militärs. Von Stephan Lina.

items.title: Ukraine seeks international support for agricultural export logistics – Vysotskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine is calling on international partners to consider mechanisms to offset additional logistics costs for agricultural exports. According to the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food, around €1.1 billion will be needed to reduce these costs during the 2026/27 marketing year.

items.title: 100% of Starshield missions were failing by day three of the new cap, a Ukrainian official says. SpaceX: “There has been no change”
items.teaser: Senior Ukrainian officials told the FT they see the cap as pressure during the peace talks, while the Pentagon has yet to explain it.

items.title: Sybiha to visit UAE for international security forum
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha will visit the United Arab Emirates on November 13-14 to attend the 16th annual Sir Bani Yas Forum, which focuses on key security challenges in the Middle East and around the world.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Saporischschja: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf 30, Rettungsarbeiten abgeschlossen
items.teaser: Durch den Einschlag eines russischen Geschosses in einem Wohnblock in Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten auf 30 gestiegen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Mychajlo Semikin, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Lithuanian police detain men who allegedly tore down Ukrainian flag from ministry building
items.teaser: Law enforcement in Vilnius arrested a 21-year-old man charged with desecrating a foreign state symbol after he allegedly pulled down and threw away a Ukrainian flag from the Ministry of Transport and Communications.

items.title: Koretskyi says fuel prices will fall as new supplies arrive
items.teaser: Petrol prices in Ukraine are expected to decline once new fuel supplies purchased at lower prices reach the country.

items.title: Göttingen: Energieminister beraten über Sicherheit
items.teaser: Sie fordern vom Bund Stromnetze besser zu schützen, auch vor Drohnen über Energiespeichern oder Umspannwerken. Reporter Dennis Pyzik berichtet.

items.title: Russia’s leaked death register turns up fewer war dead from Nepal, India, and Sri Lanka than their governments report
items.teaser: Russia told Cameroon 16 of its citizens died. A search of the same leaked register returns 33 records for Cameroon.

items.title: Korezkyj: Russen greifen erneut Hochspannungsumspannwerke an
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 13. November haben die Russen Hochspannungsumspannwerke in der Ukraine angegriffen. Außerdem standen Krankenhäuser, Logistikzentren und Wohnhäuser unter Beschuss.

items.title: Trump will never back Ukraine, O’Brien says
items.teaser: Was Donald Trump ever serious about securing peace for Ukraine? After nearly two years of U.S.-mediated negotiations between Ukraine and Russia, another round of talks on Nov. 10-11 in Abu Dhabi ended without a breakthrough. The Kyiv Independent's Martin Fornusek speaks with Phillips O'Brien,

items.title: About 35 drones assembled for Ukrainian military at defense forum in The Hague
items.teaser: A drone-building workshop was held during the European Defense Innovation Forum (EDIF 2026) in The Hague, where participants assembled about 35 drones for the Ukrainian military over two days.

items.title: UK blacklists Slavneft and says it now sanctions all ten of Russia’s top oil producers
items.teaser: The package also targets Rosneft's flagship Arctic venture Vostok Oil, major coal companies, and 11 ships linked to Russian oil and gas.

items.title: Russian drone strike causes major sunflower oil spill at facility in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike on a facility belonging to Kernel agricultural holding in the Mykolaiv region caused a sunflower oil spill covering an area of more than 3,500 square meters.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Pace of energy sector recovery is too slow
items.teaser: After reviewing strike damage in Sumy and Kyiv oblasts, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged faster energy sector recovery alongside updated mobile fire group operations to protect agricultural facilities.

items.title: Operation Carthage suspect General Duka released from pre-trial detention
items.teaser: The SSU major general denies wrongdoing and calls the case revenge from NABU. His lawyer says an appeal against the court's preventive measure is due on 26 November.

items.title: Silent final approach may let Russian jet drones slip past some of Ukraine’s acoustic sensors, ISW says
items.teaser: An additional electric motor rumored in Ukrainian military Signal chats doesn’t exist, Zelenskyy’s defense tech adviser says.

items.title: Zelensky says pace of recovery work following Russian strikes too slow
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said during a conference call on the situation in Ukraine's regions that recovery efforts following Russian strikes were progressing too slowly.

items.title: Born to Be Independent: Kyiv Independent launches a new collection for its fifth anniversary
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent is celebrating its fifth anniversary this month. To mark the occasion, we’re launching a Born to Be Independent collection — for everyone who believes in the freedom to speak their mind. Every purchase supports the Kyiv Independent's journalism in Ukraine.

items.title: Xi-Putin-Trump-Gipfel in China?
items.teaser: Peking agiert vorsichtig angesichts der Spekulationen über ein mögliches Gipfeltreffen zwischen Xi, Putin und Trump. China möchte den Eindruck vermeiden, sich zu stark in den Ukraine-Krieg einzumischen.

items.title: Ukrainische „Neptun“- Raketen treffen Produktionsstätte, Lager und Servicezentrum für Drohnen in Russland
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben in der Nacht zum 13. November eine Produktionsstätte, ein Lager und ein Servicezentrum für Drohnen in der russischen Stadt Rostow am Don mit Neptun- Raketen angegriffen, teilt der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Ukrainian oil company Korolivskyi Smak halts production amid Russian attacks and power cuts
items.teaser: Kirovohrad-based food producer Korolivskyi Smak has completed final shipments and ceased oilseed purchasing as severe power supply issues and air strike threats prevent stable factory operations.

items.title: A Yanukovych-era spokesman turned Kremlin voice survives a car bomb in Moscow, barely
items.teaser: Russian channels say he climbed out of the wreck himself before doctors put him in intensive care in critical condition.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff confirms strike on Lukoil refinery in Volgograd, oil processing units hit
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka oil refinery in Russia overnight on November 13.

items.title: Ukraine stabilized the Sloviansk front after months of Russian offensives, an analyst finds
items.teaser: Reinforcements and a new commander for the city’s defense turned things around east of one of the last big Ukrainian-held cities in Donetsk Oblast, while nearby Kramatorsk takes heavier fire.

items.title: Did drone strikes on Yandex slow Russian bots? A Ukrainian study finds indirect signs of a partial dip
items.teaser: Pro-Kremlin messaging on three of five topics CAT-UA tracked fell on 8 and 11 October, the days strikes halted two Yandex data centers.

items.title: Verfassungsschutz soll heimlich Wohnungen betreten dürfen: Bundestag beschließt Geheimdienst-Reform
items.teaser: Der Bundestag hat eine umfassende Reform der Nachrichtendienste beschlossen. BND und Verfassungsschutz sollen damit neue Befugnisse bekommen.

items.title: Car belonging to former Azarov spokesperson explodes in Moscow – media
items.teaser: A car belonging to Sergei Zavorotny, former press secretary to former Ukrainian Prime Minister Mykola Azarov, exploded in Moscow early on Friday, November 13.

items.title: Ukrainian-founded drone maker UForce raises $700 million at $6 billion valuation
items.teaser: The investment will help UForce expand production for Ukraine and supply allied countries with systems suited to modern warfare, the company said.

items.title: 13 Verletzte bei russischem Angriff auf Wohnhaus in Saporischschja, darunter fünf Kinder
items.teaser: Durch einen russischen Angriff auf Saporischschja sind 13 Menschen verletzt worden, darunter fünf Kinder, teilt der regionale Katastrophenschutz auf Telegram mit

items.title: Ukraine seeks explanation on Starshield speed restrictions from US
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 13 that the restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line, making it "impossible" to use interceptors against Shahed-type drones.

items.title: Merz: Germany will be a guaranteed participant in peace talks on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says the first peace talks involving European representatives are expected in the coming weeks, with countries represented in Abu Dhabi likely to take part.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia: Injury toll rises to 25, rescue operations completed
items.teaser: The number of people injured after Russian forces struck residential apartment buildings in Zaporizhzhia has risen to 25, including six children.

items.title: Russian attack on Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics in Kyiv injures three patients – photos
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack on the Ukrainian capital has damaged the National Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics, resulting in a fire and injuries among patients.

items.title: Ukraine has lost 400 locomotives since start of year
items.teaser: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives since Russia's full-scale invasion began. Nearly 15 attacks on railway rolling stock have been recorded since the start of November.

items.title: Russian strike on Kyiv damages National Academy of Arts building
items.teaser: A Russian aerial attack on the Ukrainian capital has caused damage to a historic 19th-century building, blowing out its windows.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports strike on key fuel supplier of Russian forces – video
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says drones hit primary processing units and storage tanks at the Volgograd refinery, which handles about 15 million tonnes of oil a year, sparking a fire.

items.title: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit Russian drone production facility, warehouse, service center in Rostov-on-Don
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Navy used its Neptune coastal missile system to strike a Russian drone production facility, warehouse and service center in Rostov-on-Don overnight on November 13.

items.title: Russia's advance in Ukraine has slowed significantly, Air Assault Forces commander says
items.teaser: Heavy casualties are limiting Moscow's ability to sustain its offensive despite its manpower advantage, Maj. Gen. Oleh Apostol, commander of Ukraine's Air Assault Forces, said during a meeting with journalists.

items.title: Top security official released on $1.4 million bail in major corruption case
items.teaser: Duka is a suspect in a sweeping investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) into scam call centers. The probe led to the ouster of Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko, who fled Ukraine in September, and implicated senior officials in his office.

items.title: Government to submit updated anti-corruption strategy to parliament soon – PM Koretskyi
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers is working on a new anti-corruption strategy that will include reforms of law enforcement agencies, in particular the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) and the State Bureau of Investigation (SBI).

items.title: Russen töten in Region Donezk vier Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer wurden vier Menschen am 12. November in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Poland charges a Ukrainian helper in Russia’s plot to blow up a freight train on Ukraine’s supply line
items.teaser: The indictment says the attackers aimed to frighten many people and sway public opinion, not just damage a railway

items.title: Ukraine’s grid operator kept all-day blackouts in parts of the country after Russia’s latest strikes on the grid
items.teaser: Russian strikes on 13 November killed four Ukrainian civilians and injured more than 40.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on apartment building in Zaporizhzhia rises to 13, including five children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian strike on a five-story apartment building in Zaporizhzhia has risen to 13, including five children.

items.title: Zelenskyy urges closer contact with US amid Starshield restrictions at the front
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president has instructed his officials to intensify contacts with the Pentagon and SpaceX as the speed limit on Starshield systems hinders the interception of Russian drones.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights commissioner: Kostiantynivka was not discussed during talks on humanitarian missions
items.teaser: Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions, though Kyiv has a priority list of occupied settlements.

items.title: Geheimdienste erhalten mehr Befugnisse im Inland und Ausland
items.teaser: Die deutschen Nachrichtendienste bekommen mehr Befugnisse für die Abwehr von Spionage, Terrorismus und Sabotage.

items.title: Russia strikes Zaporizhzhia, injures 50, including 8 children
items.teaser: Rescuers freed 14 people who had been trapped in their apartments following the strike, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said.

items.title: Kallas: Kushner finally admits Europe must help shape outcome of Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: Europe must not only be present at negotiations to end Russia’s war against Ukraine, but also have a say in their outcome.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian UAV production and service facilities
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Navy has successfully targeted a UAV production plant, a storage site, and a service centre supplying the Russian forces.

items.title: Germany to provide Ukraine with another €200m in winter aid
items.teaser: Germany's Bundestag Budget Committee approved an extra €200 million for Ukraine's electricity, heating and water supplies as Russian attacks on infrastructure continue.

items.title: European Political Community: Ukraine must set its own terms for peace and receive credible security guarantees
items.teaser: Participants at the European Political Community summit in Dublin adopted a declaration on key principles of European security, reaffirming that Ukraine itself must be involved in determining the path to peace and that European countries must have a say in decisions concerning Europe’s security.

items.title: Russian records list 11,335 foreign war dead. Ukrainian intelligence says one brigade uses Africans as human shields
items.teaser: Deaths in the leaked files suggest Russia recruited in waves: Nepal, then Sri Lanka and China, then Colombia, Kenya, and Nigeria.

items.title: Russia again targets high-voltage substations overnight – PM Koretskyi
items.teaser: Overnight on November 13, Russian forces struck high-voltage substations. Medical facilities, logistics infrastructure and residential buildings also came under attack.

items.title: Ukrainian soldiers evacuate last resident of Mala Tokmachka after five-month rescue operation
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops have rescued the last resident of the village of Mala Tokmachka in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Svitlana Podolska, 64, spent five months with the soldiers before finally reaching safer territory.

items.title: Forty European states sign joint declaration on continent's security principles
items.teaser: Released by the Élysée Palace, a new joint declaration backed by 40 European states stresses that peace terms must involve Ukraine and rejects security talks with Moscow while aggression continues.

items.title: Russia asks for a pause in the Donbas city of Kostiantynivka after more than a year of assaults failed to take it—ISW sees a bid to mass troops for nearby Druzhkivka
items.teaser: The city still stands as a Ukrainian-held ruin, and a truce there would be close to impossible to police, with Russian and Ukrainian troops fighting in the same streets.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 175 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon in Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 12. November kam es zu 175 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: UK fund puts £113 million into Ukrainian-founded Magura maker as it plans to spread production beyond Ukraine
items.teaser: Britain's wealth fund co-led UFORCE's $700 million round; UK-built Magura boats are to use over 70% British content.

items.title: Ukraine continues fortifying border with Belarus amid persistent threat – SBGS spox
items.teaser: The level of engineering and fortification work along Ukraine’s border with Belarus is high, and efforts to strengthen it are ongoing.

items.title: Russian forces strike apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, four injured, including children
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a five-story residential building in the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia, injuring at least four people, including two children.

items.title: EU foreign ministers to discuss strengthening air defence and winter aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: EU ministers prepare for a high-level Foreign Affairs Council session featuring Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, tackling winter energy grid stabilisation alongside upcoming sanctions on Russian banks and shadow fleets.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 61 across Ukraine over past day, spark fire at Kyiv hospital
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 117 long-range attack drones, Gerbera and simulator drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 13, including 63 jet-powered drones, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Ukrainian battlefield successes shape allies’ stance and influence negotiations – Air Assault Forces Commander
items.teaser: Successful Ukrainian Defense Forces offensive operations have significance not only on the battlefield but also internationally, demonstrating to partners Ukraine's ability to withstand the Russian military and regain control of its territory.

items.title: Quantum Systems: Cyberangriff auf deutschen Drohnenhersteller
items.teaser: Quantum Systems beliefert auch die Ukraine mit Drohnen. Das Start-up aus Bayern hat nach eigenen Angaben nun einen Cyberangriff feindlicher Akteure eingedämmt.

items.title: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia industrial facility kills man
items.teaser: A man has been killed as a result of a Russian strike that targeted a facility in the city and caused a fire.

items.title: Staatsschutz ermittelt: Auto von Julian Reichelt abgebrannt
items.teaser: In der Nacht zu Freitag brennt das Auto von "Nius"-Chefredakteur Julian Reichelt in Berlin. Er selbst spricht von einem gezielten Anschlag. Die Ermittlungen übernimmt der Staatsschutz.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Wolgograd: Einer der größten Raffinerien Russlands brennt
items.teaser: In russischem Wolgograd brach infolge eines Drohnenangriffs in der Nacht zum 13. November Feuer in der „Lukoil“-Raffinerie Wolgograd aus.

items.title: Prosecutor's office receives order to probe top Zelensky ally but no investigation opened so far
items.teaser: The Anti-Corruption Action Center, an independent watchdog, has lambasted acting Prosecutor General Anton Kovalskyi for refusing to open the investigation so far.

items.title: Vandalismus - Brandanschlag auf Auto von "Nius"-Chefredakteur Reichelt
items.teaser: Auf das Auto des Chefredakteurs des rechtspopulistischen Portal "Nius", Julian Reichelt, hat es in der Nacht in Berlin einen Brandanschlag gegeben.

items.title: Russian attack on Odesa kills two, injures seven
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian attack on Odesa has reached two, while the number of injured has risen to seven.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Second car bomb to hit Russia in two days
items.teaser: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has more.

items.title: Kernel suspends operations at all its oilseed processing plant following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Ukrainian agricultural holding company Kernel has suspended operations at all its oilseed processing plant and halted sunflower seed purchases following a series of large-scale Russian attacks on food industry facilities.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russia hit with second car bomb attack in two days
items.teaser: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has more.

items.title: Car explosion in Moscow reportedly injures ex-Azarov press secretary
items.teaser: Zavorotny served as press secretary during the presidency of Viktor Yanukovych in Ukraine and fled to Russia in 2014 after Yanukovych's ouster following the Euromaidan Revolution.

items.title: Cats, dogs, parrots and a dog named Raccoon: 105 animals evacuated from Oleshky during humanitarian mission
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has shared updates on 105 animals evacuated from occupied Oleshky, including a pregnant dog who gave birth to four puppies after reaching safety

items.title: Ukraine secures seizure of Paris mansion belonging to sanctioned businessman Zhevago
items.teaser: A Paris mansion worth $40 million and owned by sanctioned Ukrainian businessman Kostiantyn Zhevago has been seized at the request of the Office of the Prosecutor General of Ukraine.

items.title: Nach Putin-Treffen: US-Vermittler wollen Europa in Ukraine-Verhandlungen einbeziehen
items.teaser: Nach Putin-Treffen: US-Vermittler wollen Europa in Ukraine-Verhandlungen einbeziehen

items.title: Vascular surgeon explains how wounded people should use tourniquets to avoid losing limb
items.teaser: To preserve a limb, a tourniquet should not remain in place for more than two hours. If conditions allow, it should be loosened every two hours and then reapplied.

items.title: Informelles Treffen in Dublin: Wie einig ist sich die EU in puncto Ukraine?
items.teaser: Beim Treffen der Staat- und Regierungschefs in Dublin steht die Ukraine weiter im Fokus. Vor allem über weitere Finanzhilfen wird diskutiert. Kanzler Merz hat dabei klare Vorstellungen. Von Kathrin Schmid.

items.title: Another Ukrainian agribusiness suspends oil plant operations following Kernel
items.teaser: The Potoky oil extraction plant in Dnipro has temporarily stopped processing sunflower seeds due to power outages and security threats.

items.title: Feindlicher Angriff auf Odessa: Zwei Tote, fünf Verletzte
items.teaser: Die russischen Truppen haben am 13. November die Hafenstadt Odessa angegriffen.

items.title: Czechia could deliver first four L-39 Skyfox jets to Ukraine in 2027, foreign minister says
items.teaser: The L-39 Skyfox, manufactured by Czech company Aero Vodochody, is a subsonic jet primarily designed for military pilot training. It can also carry out light attack, reconnaissance, and aerial patrol missions.

items.title: Russia’s Volgograd refinery burns as a Ukrainian monitor says Ukraine now appears to hit whole plants, not single units
items.teaser: Ukraine has been striking Russian fuel production for two weeks straight, and this time it hit one of Lukoil’s biggest plants.

items.title: Russian offensive loses momentum as advance on frontline slows significantly – Ukraine’s Air Assault Commander
items.teaser: The pace of Russian forces' advance along the frontline has slowed significantly compared with earlier periods of the war.

items.title: Woman dies in hospital after Russian strike on bus in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: A female passenger who sustained severe injuries during a Russian attack on a public bus in Zaporizhzhia Oblast has passed away despite doctors' efforts.

items.title: Nach Affären-Beben - Elon Musk will Ex-Nvidia-Boss einstellen

items.teaser: Finland’s Ministry for Foreign Affairs is allocating €37.3 million to support Ukraine’s reconstruction under the Strategic Investment and Support for Ukraine (SISU) program.

items.title: Verhandlungen im Ukraine-Krieg gehen auch um die Rolle Europas
items.teaser: Verhandlungen im Ukraine-Krieg gehen auch um die Rolle Europas

items.title: European Commission urges SpaceX to restore Starshield services in Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Commission has called on the American aerospace company to resume satellite communication services after recent disruptions hampered the Ukrainian military.

items.title: US negotiators anticipate announcement of another trilateral meeting soon
items.teaser: American representatives are travelling to Ireland to brief Ukrainian President Zelenskyy on the outcomes of their negotiations with Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Energieministerkonferenz in Göttingen
items.teaser: Die Energiewende ist ein Thema und wie Energieanlagen besser vor Sabotage geschützt werden können.

items.title: Zelensky, Tusk discuss Ukraine’s preparations for winter, front line and diplomacy
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed Poland’s assistance in preparing Ukraine for winter, diplomatic efforts, the situation on the front line and Russian strikes during a meeting with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk on the sidelines of the European Political Community summit in Dublin.

items.title: Finland directs over €30 million to rebuild Ukraine
items.teaser: The Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs is contributing funds under the Strategic Investment and Support for Ukraine programme to strengthen critical infrastructure.

items.title: Electric shock, beating, choking — Russian commander tortured civilians in occupied Oleshky, prosecutors say
items.teaser: The Russian soldiers detained two unarmed local residents in June 2023. The civilians endured ten days of torture in dire conditions, deprived of sufficient food, water, and basic sanitation.

items.title: Beyond NATO: How JEF could become a new security alliance for Ukraine
items.teaser: Few stories are as dramatic as Ukraine's long road to NATO membership. But have we ever seriously considered the alternatives?

items.title: EU outlines ‘winter’ assistance for Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Union is mobilizing additional resources through the rescEU mechanism to step up support for Ukraine ahead of the winter season and amid Russian attacks on the country’s critical infrastructure.

items.title: Nach Spionageaffäre - Nvidia-Chef tritt zurück!
items.teaser: Jensen Huang legt sein Amt wegen Affäre mit mutmaßlicher chinesischer Spionin nieder.

items.title: UK hits 10 largest Russian oil producers with massive sanctions
items.teaser: The UK government has introduced a major package of restrictive measures targeting the shadow fleet, coal enterprises and the Kremlin's largest petroleum companies.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zlatopil in Kharkiv region: Enterprise destroyed, people injured
items.teaser: A Russian strike, reportedly involving Banderol missiles, injured a child and a man, caused extensive damage to an enterprise and damaged residential buildings.

items.title: The 161 km/h cap is back on Ukraine’s Starshield links, nearly three weeks after Kyiv got full speed restored
items.teaser: Last time, the cap lasted ten days and nobody in Washington would say who ordered it.

items.title: Why Russian losses in Ukraine are surging — again
items.teaser: As the U.S., Ukraine and Russia wrap up trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi aimed at ending the war, Russian battlefield losses continue to mount for another week. items.title: Moldova reports arrest of suspect accused of spying for Russia
items.teaser: Moldova's Security and Intelligence Service says the detainee gathered information on state institutions, particularly agencies responsible for national security, on behalf of Russian intelligence.

items.title: Estonia to provide Ukraine with additional €6.5m to prepare for winter
items.teaser: Estonia will provide €4.5 million to deliver locomotives to Ukraine and €2 million to the World Bank's SPUR 2.0 programme, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna says.

items.title: Russian drones critically damage fat and oil plant in Chernihiv Oblast
items.teaser: A civilian agricultural processing facility in Chernihiv Oblast has halted production after a series of Russian UAV attacks damaged its property and infrastructure.

items.title: As Russia’s jet drones multiply, Czechia could send Ukraine 16 Skyfox jets that are cheaper to fly than F-16s
items.teaser: Aero says Kyiv could use both training and combat versions, but won’t disclose production status or delivery dates.

items.title: Finland reports strike on Russian warship in Baltic Sea
items.teaser: The Finnish military said on Thursday that their forces had detected a “strike” on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea the previous day, but the security situation in the area remained stable.

items.title: Ukrainian serviceman recruited by Russia's FSB to help kill airborne brigade commander, SBU says
items.teaser: The investigation revealed that the serviceman "attracted the attention" of Russian intelligence while seeking romantic relationships on Telegram dating channels.

items.title: Nvidia-Chef Huang tritt nach Spionageaffäre zurück
items.teaser: Der Chef des weltgrößten Chipkonzerns Nvidia, Jensen Huang, tritt wegen einer Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spionin zurück. Seine Aufgaben übernehme vorübergehend die bisherige Finanzchefin Colette Kress, teilte der US-Konzern mit.

items.title: Danish PM concerned over new Starshield disruptions in Ukraine, vows to raise issue with US
items.teaser: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen says satellite services are essential to European defence and deterrence against Russia, warning that Ukraine and Europe cannot protect their citizens without them.

items.title: Zelensky's Office explains why Putin proposing humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka
items.teaser: Russia may use a possible humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk region, to rotate its troops and bring military equipment into the city, as it did in Oleshky.

items.title: Selenskyj: Putin will Leben in Kyjiw und anderen großen Städten der Ukraine zerstören
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat bestätigt, dass Russlands Vertreter bei den Verhandlungen in Abu Dhabi nicht befugt waren, über einen Waffenstillstand zu sprechen. Stattdessen übermittelten sie, dass ihr Präsident Putin Angriffe auf ukrainische Städte fortsetzen wolle.

items.title: Zelensky on Starshield restrictions: Some in US treat our territory as though it were not Ukrainian
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that restrictions on Starshield's operating speed over Ukrainian territory may be linked to decisions by certain U.S. officials who effectively do not recognize these territories as Ukrainian.

items.title: Ireland backs Merz's call for EU-wide financial support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee says all EU member states should contribute to Ukraine's funding, warning that the financial shortfall will grow substantially next year.

items.title: Russia strikes Naftogaz facility in Chernihiv region with two missiles
items.teaser: Russian invaders struck a Naftogaz Group oil and gas facility in the Chernihiv region with two missiles in the afternoon on November 12.

items.title: Moscow youth raids spark mobilization fears as Russia struggles to recruit soldiers
items.teaser: Russian police detained hundreds of young people in Moscow on Nov. 7, handing some of them military summonses, as Russia struggles to recruit enough men for its war against Ukraine. While the raid sparked questions about whether the Kremlin is trying to recruit more soldiers through its crackdown on youth

items.title: Kallas believes she could represent Europe in talks with Russia on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: Kaja Kallas, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission, has suggested that she could represent Europe in negotiations aimed at ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Putin wants to destroy life in Kyiv and other major Ukrainian cities – Zelensky
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that during the talks in Abu Dhabi, the Russians did not have a mandate to discuss a ceasefire. Instead, they conveyed that their ruler, Vladimir Putin, wanted to continue striking Ukrainian cities.

items.title: Putin wants Oleshky-type "humanitarian mission" in Kostiantynivka, which Russia falsely claims to control
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin has proposed a so-called humanitarian mission in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk Oblast, similar to the one in Oleshky, falsely claiming that Russian forces control the city.

items.title: Finanzchefin übernimmt: Nvidia-Chef Huang gibt wegen Spionageaffäre seinen Posten auf
items.teaser: Der Tech-Gigant Nvidia ist seinen Chef los. Jensen Huang stolpert über eine Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen Spionin und tritt zurück. Vorerst wird nun die bisherige Finanzchefin den Konzern führen.

items.title: Homes in ruins and deserted streets: what Russian-occupied Hola Prystan looks like today – video
items.teaser: Russian occupation and the 2023 Kakhovka dam disaster have devastated Hola Prystan, where most buildings are damaged or in ruins and only 45 children remain.

items.title: MEP says North Korea, like Belarus, is helping Russia abduct Ukrainian children
items.teaser: Dutch MEP Thijs Reuten says North Korea and Belarus are involved in Russia's abduction of Ukrainian children and is calling for expanded EU sanctions against those responsible.

items.title: Zelensky urges Europe to pay attention to Russia-US talks on ‘new security system’ in Europe
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has urged European leaders to pay close attention to talks between Russia and the United States on security in Europe.

items.title: Generalstab: seit dem 30. Oktober die fünf größten russischen Raffinerien getroffen
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben seit dem 30. Oktober die fünf größten russischen Raffinerien getroffen: in Omsk, Kirischi, Rjasan, Nischni Nowgorod und Jaroslawl, teilte der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: EPG-Treffen in Irland: Europa will mit an den Tisch
items.teaser: Kurze Gespräche und viel Diplomatie: Beim Treffen der Europäischen Politischen Gemeinschaft geht es heute um die Nachbereitung der Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi und Moskau. Mit dabei: Selenskyj und der US-Sondergesandte Witkoff. Von S. López.

items.title: Merz sees positive signs Russia may be ready for talks involving Europe
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has said that positive signals emerged from the talks in Abu Dhabi, indicating that Russia may be ready to acknowledge the need for European involvement in further negotiations aimed at ending its war against Ukraine.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,616,330 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,150 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Ukraine's Anastasiia Osadchuk wins world amateur chess title
items.teaser: Ukrainian chess player Anastasiia Osadchuk has won a world title in amateur chess.

items.title: Three women injured in Russian drone attack on bus in Zaporizhzhia district
items.teaser: Around 12-15 people were on the bus in the Zaporizhzhia district when the drone hit it. One of those injured is in a serious condition.

items.title: Russia fires Iskanders at Ukraine. A satellite image shows what Ukraine’s missiles left of a building at a Russian plant that makes their parts
items.teaser: The plant in Oryol supplies parts for Russia’s ballistic and cruise missiles, which is why Ukraine has gone after it twice.

items.title: European Parliament calls for Russia's actions against Ukrainian children to be recognised as genocide
items.teaser: The European Parliament has urged EU countries to recognise Russia's deportation of Ukrainian children as genocide, stressing that their return must not be used as a bargaining chip in peace talks.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike five of Russia's largest oil refineries since Oct 30
items.teaser: Since October 30, Ukraine's Defense Forces have struck five of Russia's largest oil refineries: Omsk, Kirishi, Ryazan, Nizhny Novgorod and Yaroslavl.

items.title: Trump promised Americans Russian diesel. Russia doubled its exports, and none of it went to the US
items.teaser: US buyers have refused the cargoes over legal risks, so the extra Russian fuel is going to other markets instead.

items.title: Russian business is shrinking, with nearly twice as many companies folding as starting
items.teaser: The extractive sector saw net growth between January and September 2026, but 208,500 Russian organisations exited the market amid deteriorating economic conditions.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia refuses to discuss de-escalation in Black Sea, Putin wants to go on striking energy infrastructure – video
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president says Moscow refused to discuss a halt to attacks on energy infrastructure or reducing hostilities in the Black Sea during two days of Abu Dhabi talks.

items.title: Meeting between Putin and US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner begins at Kremlin
items.teaser: The US envoys arrived in Moscow from Abu Dhabi, where they took part in two days of closed-door trilateral negotiations involving Ukraine, Russia and the US.

items.title: Estonian PM says Costa and Kallas should represent EU in talks with Russia
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal believes that European Council President Antonio Costa and EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas should represent Europe in negotiations on ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Gespräche in Abu Dhabi: Was haben sie der Ukraine gebracht?
items.teaser: Die ersten trilateralen Gespräche zwischen der Ukraine, den USA und Russland seit neun Monaten endeten mit einer Einigung über einen Gefangenenaustausch. Ist das Ergebnis ein echter Erfolg und ein Schritt zum Frieden?

items.title: Irish PM comments on number of European negotiators in talks with Russia
items.teaser: Irish PM Micheál Martin has said EU leaders will formally discuss Europe's negotiating representation during an informal meeting of the Council of the EU on 13 November.

items.title: Latvian PM backs German chancellor's ultimatum on aid to Ukraine: "It is the perfect strategy"
items.teaser: Latvian PM Andris Kulbergs has called Merz's demand to link the EU's seven-year budget to all states funding Ukraine "the perfect strategy" for European security.

items.title: Russian colonel reportedly killed in car explosion near St. Petersburg
items.teaser: Russian military officials and other figures involved in Moscow's full-scale invasion have previously been targeted in car bombings and other attacks, sometimes in Ukrainian-led operations.

items.title: European Parliament adopts resolution on Ukrainian children under occupation and those deported to Russia
items.teaser: The European Parliament has adopted a resolution entitled "Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine."

items.title: Ukraine’s Patriots stand empty, Zelenskyy warns, while Italy, one of its Aster suppliers, says: “We have some to keep for ourselves”
items.teaser: The Asters arm Ukraine’s SAMP/T batteries, which back up its Patriots against Russian ballistic missiles.

items.title: Tsikhanouskaya says Belarus must be included in Russia-Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: "Without a free and democratic Belarus, there will be no security, neither for Ukraine nor for European countries," Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya said.

items.title: Car catches fire after drone crashes in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district – Klitschko
items.teaser: A passenger car caught fire in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after a Russian drone crashed.

items.title: Zelensky arrives at European Political Community summit
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived at the European Political Community (EPC) summit in Dublin.

items.title: Ireland wants Ukraine’s final EU clusters open within seven weeks. Hungary still hasn’t said yes
items.teaser: Budapest has raised no new minority-rights demands, Kyiv says, but it has held up the last two clusters since June.

items.title: A second Russian strike on a blaze near Kyiv killed two firefighters, hours before missiles and jet drones hit 17 sites across Ukraine
items.teaser: The firefighters were already at work on the first fire when Russia struck again. The overnight attack that followed hit a Kyiv apartment block and cut power in western Ukraine.

items.title: One killed, seven injured as Russian drone hits apartment building in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike caused a fire in a nine-story residential building in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district.

items.title: Drei Tage in Brand: Spezialeinheiten griffen zwei russische Munitionsdepots im Süden an
items.teaser: Spezialeinsatzkräfte der Einheit „Omega“ griffen zwei Munitionsdepots der russischen Besatzungsarmee auf Brigadeebene im Süden der Ukraine an.

items.title: Starshield speed restrictions return, hampering efforts to intercept Russian drones, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Unfortunately, this is helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: Russia’s officials have a habit of dying suddenly. Now its ambassador to the US is dead at 66 in Moscow after US midterms
items.teaser: The latest death touches the diplomat Moscow had sent to rebuild ties with a Washington it hoped to win over.

items.title: Spain resumes Russian LNG purchases ahead of key deadline, new report reveals
items.teaser: Spain imported 138,000 metric tonnes of Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) in October despite having phased out imports from Moscow in September, according to a Nov. 12 report by the Center for Research on Energy and Clean Air.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 10, injure 40 across Ukraine over past day, as peace talks end
items.teaser: Russian forces launched Iskander-M/KN-23/S-400 ballistic missiles, Zircon anti-ship missiles, Gerbera, Banderol/Dan-T and 123 long-range attack drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 12.

items.title: EU verhängt neue Sanktionen gegen Russland am Montag – Barrot
items.teaser: Die Europäische Union (EU) wird am Montag, dem 16. November, neue Sanktionen gegen Russland verhängen, erklärte der französische Außenminister Jean-Noël Barrot auf Plattform X. Er reagierte damit auf das Einreiseverbot Moskaus für zwei französische Abgeordnete und zwei Journalisten.

items.title: A fake front line that exists only on Russian state maps is set to grow all winter, ISW expects, after Russia’s envoys carried it to the peace table
items.teaser: Moscow pairs these paper conquests with a demand for whole Ukrainian oblasts, including towns its soldiers have never reached.

items.title: Russian colonel killed by a remote-detonated car bomb a day after Ukrainian drones hit a nearby Baltic port
items.teaser: The officer reportedly served in the air force and air defense army based in St. Petersburg, though no one has tied the two events together.

items.title: Gipfel in Dublin: US-Sondergesandte wollen EU und Ukraine einbinden
items.teaser: Tina Hassel, ARD Brüssel, zzt. Dublin, zu den EU-Beratungen über Ukraine-Gespräche

items.title: An der Front 167 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 11. November, zu 167 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Donnerstag, dem 12. November, melden.

items.title: Luftabwehr schießt ab/neutralisiert 89 russische Kamikaze-Drohnen und 5 Drohnen „Banderol“
items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 89 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1722: Russia sends heavier team to Abu Dhabi peace talks, but its negotiators insist on Kremlin’s original war aims
items.teaser: Ukraine reportedly tests air-launched interceptors at the edge of space as Russia’s Oreshnik threat looms.
